name: Côte d'Ivoire
prevalence_note: The BCEAO has warned the public about fraudulent messages and sites that misuse its name. Orange Côte d'Ivoire publishes a 'stop arnaques' guide for Orange Money, covering secret codes and prize or link tricks. Ivorian cybercrime reporting (PLCC) has also been cited on APK links aimed at mobile-money accounts.
cross_border_note: Calls and SMS are usually in French and may come from Ivorian mobiles or from numbers made to look like a bank or an operator care line. BCEAO-themed lures also appear across the UEMOA area.

scams.name: Faux message ou site au nom de la BCEAO

red_flag_keywords.text: invokes a mandatory update in the name of the regional central bank
sends a link supposedly needed to unblock an account
asks for account codes to be sent to a supposed central-bank desk

scams.signals_en: A message, call or website borrows the name of the Central Bank of West African States and tells the person to open a link, fill a form, or hand over account codes to avoid a blockage or a penalty.
scams.legit_en: The BCEAO has issued a public notice warning about fraudulent messages that refer to the institution. Official contact is made through the Bank's own published channels, not through an unsolicited form or a code collected on a call.
bait_tactics: Je ne remplis pas un formulaire arrivé par message au nom de la BCEAO, je n'ai saisi aucun guichet officiel.
Le lien que vous indiquez ne correspond pas au site que j'utilise déjà pour suivre cette institution.
Je ne communique aucun code secret dans le cadre d'une prétendue mise à jour monétaire.

scams.name: Arnaque Orange Money par code ou lien
scams.name_en: Orange Money secret-code or link scam

red_flag_keywords.text: solicits the Orange Money secret code on an unsolicited call
sends a validation link presented as a way to credit the wallet
asks the customer to type an SMS code during the call

scams.signals_en: A caller or a chat lure, often dressed as a credit, a security check or a merchant payment, asks the customer to reveal the Orange Money secret code, type an SMS code, or open a validation link.
scams.legit_en: Orange Côte d'Ivoire's official anti-scam pages tell customers how to protect an Orange Money account, including not handing over the secret code or following unsolicited validation links sent in a message.
bait_tactics: Le solde Orange Money sur cet écran n'a pas changé, donc je n'ouvre pas un lien de 'crédit' reçu par message.
Je ne dicte pas le code secret de ce portefeuille, y compris à quelqu'un qui se dit conseiller.
Le SMS de confirmation n'est pas arrivé sur cette ligne Moov, il n'y a donc aucun code à relire.
